Trust.Name: Trust
Trust.Description: +1 to Charisma, Seduction and Persuasion against other humans.

Stubbornness.Name: Stubbornness
Stubbornness.Description: Reroll a failed Resist Coercion or Courage check (up to 3 times per session; take the highest result; if the reroll fails, this ability cannot be used again).

Marksman.Name: Marksman
Marksman.Description: +2 to Archery; draw and string a bow without spending an action.

OneWithNature.Name: One with Nature
OneWithNature.Description: Animals are friendly and do not attack unless provoked; automatically find common or plentiful plant substances if they naturally occur in the area.

Tough.Name: Tough
Tough.Description: Skin has a natural stopping power of 2, added to any armor's stopping power and unaffected by ablation damage.

Witcher.Name: Witcher
Witcher.Note: Originally humans, transformed by mutations during the Trial of the Grasses.

EnhancedSenses.Name: Enhanced Senses
EnhancedSenses.Description: No penalties in dim light; +1 to Awareness; can track by scent.

MutantResilience.Name: Mutant Resilience
MutantResilience.Description: Immune to diseases; can use mutagens.

DulledEmotions.Name: Dulled Emotions
DulledEmotions.Description: No Courage checks against Intimidation; −4 to Empathy (minimum 1); Empathy cannot exceed 6.

LightningReflexes.Name: Lightning Reflexes
LightningReflexes.Description: +1 to Reflex and Dexterity (these values may exceed 10).
